title: Food Processing Technology

questions.question: Mention the advancement in food processing from the 20th century. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html: • Advancements: automation, refrigeration, UHT, freeze-drying, improved packaging.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: State how food processing affect vitamin C content / [CO2]
questions.solution_html: • Vitamin C reduces due to heat-sensitive degradation during processing.

questions.question: Define cryogenic freezing. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html: • Cryogenic freezing uses extremely low temperatures like liquid nitrogen (–196°C).
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: State the critical levels of sugar and salt concentration that inhibit microbial growth. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html: • Sugar >65% solids; salt 15–20% inhibits microbial growth.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: State the typical temperature range used in sterilization. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html: • Sterilization temperature range: 110–121°C.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Report one preventive measure for sugar bloom. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html: • Prevent sugar bloom by proper tempering and stable storage temperature.

questions.solution_html: • Pickling methods: Salt pickling, Vinegar pickling, Fermented pickling.

questions.question: Describe one defect and its prevention in sauce processing. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html: • Sauce defect: Syneresis; prevented by correct starch use and cooking.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe the function of roasting in peanut butter preparation. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html: • Roasting peanuts improves flavour, colour, and reduces moisture.

questions.question: State the sterilization temperature and time for canned soups. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html: • Canned soups sterilized at 121°C for 15–20 minutes.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe the reason for cloudy jelly formation. / [CO4] [1x10 = 10]
questions.solution_html: • Cloudy jelly occurs due to improper straining or excess pectin.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Write short notes on the benefits and limitations of secondary processing. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Benefits & limitations of secondary processing:
  • Benefits: longer shelf life, improved sensory quality, value addition, reduced waste,
  • convenience.
  • Limitations: nutrient loss, need for equipment, higher cost, contamination risk.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the objectives and methods of conventional cooking. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Objectives & methods of conventional cooking:
  • Objectives: improve palatability, digestibility, safety, flavour.
  • Methods: boiling, steaming, baking, roasting, frying, pressure cooking.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe the LTLT, HTST and UHT methods of pasteurization. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html: • LTLT, HTST & UHT pasteurization: LTLT: 63°C for 30 min. HTST: 72°C for 15 sec. UHT: 135–150°C for 2–5 sec.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the principle of high-temperature preservation. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Principle of high-temperature preservation:
  • Destroys microorganisms, denatures enzymes, achieves commercial sterility.
  • Used in blanching, pasteurization, sterilization.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the packaging and storage requirements for ketchup. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• Packaging & storage requirements for ketchup:
  • Use glass/plastic containers, hot-fill, proper sealing.
  • Store in cool dry place; refrigerate after opening.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Discuss the importance of maintaining proper sugar–pectin–acid balance in jam making. / [CO4] [5x4 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Sugar–pectin–acid balance in jam:
  • Affects gel formation, prevents syneresis/crystallization.
  • Ideal: pH 3.0–3.3, 65% TSS, correct pectin level.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe the entire canning process, covering the stages of preparation, processing, and safety precautions. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Canning process:
  • Selection & grading, washing, peeling, cutting, blanching.
  • Filling, exhausting, sealing, sterilization at 110–121°C, cooling, storage.
  • Safety: hygiene, correct time–temperature, avoid under-processing.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Discuss the principles, types, and limitations of refrigeration in food preservation. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Refrigeration – principles, types, limitations:
  • Principle: slows microbial growth by lowering temperature.
  • Types: natural, mechanical, cryogenic.
  • Limitations: energy use, does not kill microbes, temperature fluctuations.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Explain the overall contribution of low temperature preservation to modern food technology. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Contribution of low-temperature preservation:
  • Extends shelf life, retains nutrients and colour, reduces waste.
  • Supports frozen/chilled food industry and global supply chains.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025

questions.question: Describe in detail the complete process of marmalade production, including extraction, boiling, and packaging. / [CO4] [10x2 = 20]
questions.solution_html:
• Marmalade production:
  • Washing, peeling, juice extraction, peel cutting.
  • Boiling with sugar, concentrating to 65% TSS, adding peel.
  • Testing endpoint, filling hot, cooling, sealing.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
